Context: 1. Reservation for SCs/ST s

- Order 95 of Section 2.  
- (c) Action against Government servants who get appointed on the · basis of false SC/ST/OBC certificates in case of Permanent Government servants.An inquiry as prescribed in Rule 14 of CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965 may be held and if the charges are proved, he/she should be removed or dismissed from service. In no circumstances, should any penalty be imposed. - Order 16, Section 1.
